short: Atta — the engine for the Den: resolve, route, render
is: Atta, the host-agnostic engine for the Den: it resolves the tree, enforces its structural rules, asks the host about each node through one object-safe trait Atta defines, and renders files. Types and content are opaque to it; the host answers per type with an exhaustive match in application, never a runtime registry. It lives in this workspace as a crate only until it is split into its own library.
conventions: Never depends on another workspace crate and never names a Zurfur type — host-agnostic by construction, so it can be split out unchanged.
Used by application only; the API never imports it.
Its role is fixed: resolve, enforce structure, route changes, render. How it does that grows only as real needs appear, never ahead of them.
Nothing reads a node except through Atta; a payload is served only after its hash verifies, and until that check exists no payload is served at all.
Fails closed: one uniform not-found, no stored level means Private, and a mount whose target is not directly under a top-level directory is refused.

fs.role: crate manifest — external crates only, never a workspace crate

fs.name: src/fake.rs
fs.role: test-only Host over an in-memory tree that records every call

fs.name: src/host.rs
fs.role: the one Host trait (child, children, mounts, kind, admit; no payload method) and the values it speaks: Viewer, Lift, Found, Mount, Access, Reach, Admission

fs.name: src/lib.rs
fs.role: façade: the crate doc and the public surface

fs.name: src/list.rs
fs.role: Resolver::list: one page of an open directory; Private and refused entries drop before the sort and the cut; ordered by name_order, then segment, cards by a keyed hash

fs.name: src/metadata.rs
fs.role: Metadata, the closed per-node field set, and Type, the opaque type key

fs.name: src/name.rs
fs.role: ShowableName, a name safe to show: input at most 2048 bytes, no line or paragraph separator; stripped (blank ends; fillers and zero-width spaces inside), then not empty, no Cc, no unassigned default-ignorable, no Cf but the joiners, subdivision-flag tags and a Mongolian vowel separator inside a Mongolian word. NodeName is a ShowableName with no / (the / clause outranks every rule but the length)

fs.name: src/ordering.rs
fs.role: name_order: digit runs by value, every other character on its own and case-insensitively (a final sigma as σ), then the name itself (a file manager's order); proptests.rs checks it is a total order

fs.name: src/page.rs
fs.role: PageToken (a version and an offset, hex; FromStr and Display) and Listing

fs.name: src/path.rs
fs.role: RealPath, a node real path from the global root

fs.name: src/resolve.rs
fs.role: Resolver::resolve_path: a typed Den path from the viewer root, the level formula, standing along the real path, mounts and the mount guard, admit at each step, one NotFound; Caps

fs.name: src/segment.rs
fs.role: Segment, a node key: the ASCII allowlist, 1 to 2048 bytes, never . or ..

fs.name: tests/no_workspace_dependency.rs
fs.role: guard: atta depends on no workspace crate, of any kind (cargo metadata)

ShowableName carries Unicode general category Cf as a hand table from the Unicode Character Database 16.0.0 (generated with Python unicodedata 16.0.0, 2026-10-10; checked unchanged against 17.0.0 and 18.0.0); std has no general-category query and no crate was added. Regenerate it when Unicode adds Cf code points.

ShowableName's blank set is White_Space (std's char::is_whitespace, following the toolchain's Unicode version), Default_Ignorable_Code_Point as a hand table from UCD 16.0.0 DerivedCoreProperties.txt (checked equal against 17.0.0 and 18.0.0, 2026-10-11; it holds the joiners and the Hangul fillers U+115F, U+1160, U+3164, U+FFA0), and a named table of visible fillers in neither: U+2800, U+1D159, U+16FE4, U+13441 and U+13442. The unassigned default-ignorables (DI and Cn, the same in 16.0.0 to 18.0.0) are a separate hand table, refused inside a name. A test pins char::UNICODE_VERSION to the versions the tables were checked against, so a toolchain bump forces a re-check.

ShowableName parsing (NodeName is a ShowableName with no /, its / rule checked after the length rule and before every other): the length, separator and reserved rules (noncharacters U+FDD0-U+FDEF and U+xFFFE/U+xFFFF, and U+FFFC) run on the input and win. Then the name is read in units (a subdivision flag is one unit: U+1F3F4, then 3 to 7 tag digits or tag lowercase letters, the shape of a subdivision id, then the cancel tag; every other character is its own). Blank units are stripped from both ends, and so are combining marks (general category M, a hand table from UCD 18.0.0, a superset of 16.0.0 and 17.0.0) that lead with no base, keeping the joiners and variation selectors (VS1-16, the supplement, the Mongolian FVS) right after the last non-blank unit; fillers, the zero-width spaces U+200B, U+2060, U+FEFF, the invisible marks U+034F, U+17B4, U+17B5, and, in each gap between two non-blank units, every joiner but the first and every selector but the first are stripped from inside (spaces in the gap stay but don't restart the count). A name with nothing left is Empty. What is left may not hold a control character, an unassigned default-ignorable, or a Cf other than the joiners and a flag's tags; U+180E is kept only between an assigned Mongolian letter (Lo or Lm) or selector and an assigned Mongolian letter. The stripped form is what ShowableName holds. Names are never looked up (keys are Segments), so the parse is the one normalizing function. Interior non-U+0020 space separators (NBSP, U+3000, U+2000-U+200A) are kept.
Not yet in Atta, waiting for the first payload: the payload hash in Metadata, Payload, and attributes. Links resolve nowhere yet: a symlink handed to Atta fails closed as absent.
